description: This PHP source file generates the 'Connection Status' page of a web user interface for a network gateway. It includes server-side logic to fetch network interface, IPv6, DNS, Wi-Fi, WAN, MoCA, and other network settings, as well as client-side JavaScript for UI interactions and styling. The file integrates multiple includes for header, footer, and other components, and outputs a detailed status report of the device's network connections.
